l1.text: Thanks for the time today. Here's a quick recap of what we covered, and how we move forward.

l2.text: The big takeaway: SBS Digital doesn't have a demand problem. It has a capacity problem.

l3.text: New reps leave before they ramp, and the ones who stay spend too little of their day actually selling.

l4.text: Cut first-year attrition by ten points, and we win back about twelve sellers of capacity, without adding headcount.

l5.text: The plan comes down to four priorities. Keep the sellers we hire. Give reps their time back. Route the right buyer, fast. And compete on ease.

l6.text: All on one operating model and one dashboard, so every site works from the same numbers.

l7.text: The economics: three point one million invested, three point seven million in new year-one bookings, and payback around month six.

l8.text: From here, the first thirty days are about listening and setting the baseline. By sixty, we pilot. By ninety, we scale what works.

l9.text: Five decisions will shape year one, and we'd love your input on each. Thank you.
